name: Aadhaar - update address
aliases: aadhar aadhaar adhar address change mugavari maatram ஆதார் முகவரி மாற்றம் update
documents: Mobile number linked to Aadhaar (to receive the OTP for online update)
ONE valid Proof of Address from UIDAI's list, e.g. passport, ration card, voter ID, driving licence, recent electricity/water/gas bill, bank passbook or statement
Clear scanned copy or photo (PDF/JPG) of that address proof
Debit/credit card, UPI or net banking to pay the update fee
steps: Go to myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in and log in with your Aadhaar number and OTP
Choose 'Update Aadhaar' and then 'Address'
Check the details and upload the scanned address proof
Pay the fee shown and note the Service Request Number (SRN)
Track the status with the SRN; download the updated Aadhaar after approval
If your mobile is not linked, visit an Aadhaar update centre with the original proof
note: Accepted documents and fees can change - confirm on the UIDAI site.

name: Aadhaar - update mobile number, biometrics or photo
aliases: aadhar aadhaar mobile number link phone biometric fingerprint photo iris ஆதார் மொபைல் எண்
documents: The new mobile number you want to link (keep the phone with you)
steps: Find the nearest Aadhaar enrolment/update centre (uidai.gov.in, 'Locate an Enrolment Centre')
Fill the update form at the centre
Give fingerprints, iris scan or photo if required
Pay the fee and keep the acknowledgement slip (URN)
Track the status with the URN
note: Mobile number and biometric updates need an in-person visit.

name: Aadhaar - correct name, date of birth or gender
aliases: aadhar aadhaar name correction date of birth dob gender spelling ஆதார் பெயர் திருத்தம் பிறந்த தேதி
documents: ONE document proving the correct name or date of birth from UIDAI's list, e.g. passport, birth certificate, 10th (SSLC) certificate or marksheet, PAN card, driving licence
Mobile number linked to Aadhaar for the OTP
steps: Try online first: myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in, Update Aadhaar, choose the field to correct
Upload the supporting document and pay the fee
If online is not allowed in your case, visit an Aadhaar update centre with the original document
Note the SRN/URN and track the status
note: The number of times name, DOB or gender can be changed is limited - check UIDAI rules first.

name: Income certificate (Tamil Nadu)
aliases: income certificate varumana sandrithal வருமானச் சான்றிதழ் vao revenue
documents: Proof of income, e.g. salary slip, or a self-declaration of income
Active mobile number for OTP and status SMS
steps: Go to tnesevai.tn.gov.in or your nearest e-Sevai centre
Choose Revenue Department, then Income Certificate
Fill the form and upload the documents
Pay the fee and note the application number
The revenue officer verifies it; download the certificate once approved
note: Exact documents can vary by district - confirm at your e-Sevai centre.

name: Community (caste) certificate (Tamil Nadu)
aliases: community certificate caste jathi sandrithal சாதிச் சான்றிதழ் சமூகச் சான்றிதழ் sc st bc mbc
documents: Parent's earlier community certificate, or school Transfer Certificate (TC) showing the community
steps: Go to tnesevai.tn.gov.in or your nearest e-Sevai centre
Choose Revenue Department, then Community Certificate
Fill the form and upload the documents
Pay the fee and note the application number
Download the certificate once the officer approves
note: Exact documents can vary by district - confirm at your e-Sevai centre.

name: Ration (smart) card - new, add member or address change
aliases: ration card family card smart card add member name remove ரேஷன் குடும்ப அட்டை
documents: Passport photo of the family head
Deletion certificate from the old card if you are shifting from another family card
steps: Go to tnpds.gov.in and register or log in with your mobile number
Choose the service (new card, add member or address change)
Upload the documents and submit
Note the reference number and track it; an officer may verify your address
note: Confirm the current process on the TNPDS portal.

name: Voter ID - new registration or correction
aliases: voter id epic election card vote வாக்காளர் அடையாள அட்டை
documents: Age proof (birth certificate, 10th certificate or passport)
Address proof (Aadhaar, ration card or utility bill)
steps: Go to voters.eci.gov.in
Fill Form 6 for new registration (Form 8 for corrections)
Upload the documents and submit
Track with the reference ID; a Booth Level Officer may visit to verify
note: Confirm the current forms on the Election Commission portal.
